_comment: Every value records its origin: the paper (with the exact place), the published code or our own decision. This table goes to the appendix of the report.

seeds.source: decision: one seed per configuration (compute). Preliminary runs with three seeds showed a spread small next to the differences between methods

steps_grid.source: decision (requested by the supervisor): sampling steps, one network evaluation each

beta_start.source: paper: Ho et al. (2020), Section 4 (linear schedule)

beta_end.source: paper: Ho et al. (2020), Section 4 (linear schedule)

datasets.source: published code: Gulrajani et al. (2017), gan_toy.py, for the first two; decision for the third

sigma0.source: papers: standard Gaussian noise of Lipman et al. (2023), Section 4, and Tong et al. (2024), Algorithm 3

batch_size.source: published code: Gulrajani et al. (2017), gan_toy.py (BATCH_SIZE = 256); also the minibatch of the FM-OT coupling

lr.source: decision: Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2015, Algorithm 1, default betas 0.9 and 0.999) without per-method tuning

n_test.source: decision: test sample of every mixture, drawn once with its own generator

n_validation.source: decision: validation sample to follow the loss during training

reflow_pairs.source: decision on the number; procedure of Liu et al. (2023), Algorithm 1

reflow_pair_nfe.source: decision: Heun (Karras et al., 2022, Algorithm 1 without noise) with 100 evaluations

n_trajectories.source: decision: trajectories drawn in the figures

sigma0_sweep.source: decision (requested by the supervisor): very concentrated, intermediate, standard and very wide noise

batch_sweep.source: decision: minibatch sizes of the coupling; Tong et al. (2024) and Pooladian et al. (2023) show that the coupling approaches the optimal plan as the batch grows

digits.source: decision (requested by the supervisor): two classes keep the study about the methods

val_fraction.source: decision: 10% of the official training images of the two digits

unet_channels.source: decision: U-Net of Ronneberger et al. (2015) with two resolutions, calibrated to the compute of an Apple M1

iterations.source: decision: calibrated to the compute of an Apple M1

batch_size.source: paper: Ho et al. (2020), Appendix B (batch 128 on CIFAR-10); also the minibatch of the FM-OT coupling

batch_sweep.source: decision: test of H6 with FM as the control, since with a fixed number of iterations a larger minibatch also shows more data; 512 is the largest that the compute of an Apple M1 allowed

lr.source: paper: Ho et al. (2020), Appendix B (2e-4 on CIFAR-10)

grad_clip.source: published code: Ho et al. (2020), diffusion repository (gradient norm clipped at 1)

ema.source: decision: Ho et al. (2020), Appendix B, use 0.9999 with far more iterations

n_eval.source: decision: generated images per sampler and number of steps, close to the 1992 test images

reflow_pairs.source: decision on the number; procedure of Liu et al. (2023), Algorithm 1

reflow_pair_nfe.source: decision: Heun (Karras et al., 2022, Algorithm 1 without noise) with 32 evaluations

ambiguity_threshold.source: decision: an image is a clear digit if the classifier gives it probability >= 0.9

n_samples_saved.source: decision: sample grids for the figures

relevance._comment: With one seed, two values differ relevantly only if the larger exceeds the smaller by more than this fraction: twice the median relative standard deviation over three seeds in preliminary runs of the study (same networks and training protocol).

w1.source: measured: median relative standard deviation of W1 over three seeds in preliminary runs, 0.18, times two

straightness.source: measured: median relative standard deviation of the straightness over three seeds in preliminary runs, 0.124, times two

fd.source: measured: median relative standard deviation of the FD over three seeds in preliminary runs on the ten digits, 0.028, times two
